rationale.complete: Round 1 done; round 1b re-evaluation on deterministic labels, the DQ4 work ledger and DQ6 ballots done, with a native layer (#26 per round, #31 and #40 in work). The frozen holdout test (#22, #28, #45) and a drive-vs-coupling kinetic model are not run.
rationale.faithfulness: The core prediction (sign of J set by goal mode) failed and no first-order consensus passed; the effective ferromagnetic coupling beats the nulls and now also predicts coupling in work commits (D 0 -> 1), but drive and coupling are still not separated and the post hoc ownership pattern meets a counterexample (#35).
rationale.usefulness: The attention-based coupling-beyond-fields statistic now tracks duplicated work: agents commit to the repos they attend (84%) and herd there in 4/6 shared weeks. A cheap monitor with modest evidence; the 'assign ownership' design rule is still post hoc.

one_line: Agents herd onto shared projects whatever the goal, in commits as well as attention; spread appears only as fixed ownership.
